zh.privacy.sub: 我們如何蒐集、使用與保護您的個人資料
zh.privacy.metaDesc: 墾趣旅遊個人資料蒐集處理之告知事項：蒐集主體、蒐集項目、儲存期間、資料安全與當事人權益。
zh.privacy.s1Body: {name}（以下稱「本公司」）深知個人資料之重要性，並依據《個人資料保護法》相關規定，妥善處理您於使用本網站時所提供之個人資料。本政策為本公司處理個人資料之告知文件。
zh.privacy.s2Body: 當您透過本網站之聯絡表單向本公司洽詢時，本公司會蒐集下列資料：
zh.privacy.dataContactVal: 辨識您的身分，以便與您聯繫
zh.privacy.dataContact2: 電子郵件信箱、電話號碼
zh.privacy.dataContact2Val: 作為聯繫您及回覆洽詢事項之管道
zh.privacy.dataRequest: 預計活動日期、預計參與人數、活動類型
zh.privacy.dataRequestVal: 評估可行性並擬定專屬行程提案
zh.privacy.dataTechVal: 瞭解您的需求與企業背景，設計符合目標之方案
zh.privacy.dataIpVal: 記錄於伺服器端，用於防範機器人與垃圾郵件濫用，不作為行銷用途
zh.privacy.dataOptional: 以上除聯絡人姓名與電子郵件外，其餘欄位皆為選填
zh.privacy.s2Note: 本網站另使用 Google reCAPTCHA v3 進行機器人辨識，該服務會將部分技術資訊傳送至 Google（詳見第四點說明）。
zh.privacy.s3Body: 本公司蒐集上述資料之目的如下：
zh.privacy.purposeService: 提供旅遊服務及活動規劃
zh.privacy.purposeServiceVal: 依您的需求擬定行程、安排交通住宿餐飲及相關服務
zh.privacy.purposeContractVal: 簽訂旅遊定型化契約、辦理訂金與尾款、處理退費與取消事宜
zh.privacy.purposeStatuteVal: 保存交易紀錄、防止詐欺、防範惡意程式攻擊及處理客訴
zh.privacy.s4Title: 四、第三方服務與國外傳輸
zh.privacy.s4Body: 本網站部分功能透過第三方服務提供，這些服務商可能接觸您的資料。本公司就下列服務向您說明：
zh.privacy.recaptchaBody: 本網站使用 Google reCAPTCHA v3 進行機器人與自動化程式辨識。當您送出聯絡表單時，Google 會接收與該次操作相關的技術資訊。
zh.privacy.recaptchaBody2: 依 Google 隱私權政策，該資訊可能用於其廣告與個人化用途。Google 為境外接收者，該項傳輸另受我國相關法令之規範。若您不願意使用此服務，可於瀏覽器設定中停用 JavaScript，惟表單將無法正常送出。
zh.privacy.s5Body: 本公司僅在下列情況下提供您的個人資料予第三方，且均不逾越蒐集目的之必要範圍：
zh.privacy.shareCloudVal: 本網站託管於 Cloudflare，用於內容快取、表單接收與資料儲存，該業者位於境外。
zh.privacy.sharePartnerVal: 交通、住宿、餐飲、場地等履約必要之供應商，僅提供執行該項服務所必需的最小資料。
zh.privacy.s6Body: 本公司採取下列措施保護您的個人資料：資料以加密連線（TLS）傳輸；資料儲存於具存取控管之資料庫；僅授權人員得存取；網站設有機器人防護機制。若不幸發生個資外洩，本公司將依《個人資料保護法》規定通知主管機關及受影響當事人。
zh.privacy.s7Body: 您的個人資料保存至下列期間中最長者為止：洽詢事項完成後 2 年；已成立之旅遊契約則保存至該契約履行完畢後 5 年（依稅捐、會計及旅遊業相關法令規定）；或您要求刪除且無其他法令保留義務為止。
zh.privacy.s8Body: 依《個人資料保護法》規定，您得就本公司持有的您的個人資料，行使下列權利：查閱與閱覽、請求更正、請求刪除、請求處理利用之限制、請求提供資料移轉。欲行使任一權利，請來信 {email}，我們將於法定期間內回覆。若您認為本公司的處理方式違反法令，得向中央主管機關提起申訴。
zh.privacy.contactUs: 如對本政策有任何疑問，請與我們聯繫

zh.terms.s1Body: 本條款適用於您瀏覽本網站、透過本網站聯絡我們，以及向 {name} 預訂旅遊產品或接受其相關服務之情形。本條款內容依據《旅行社法》與《旅遊契約樣張》等相關法令訂定。
zh.terms.s2Title: 二、旅遊契約之成立與內容
zh.terms.s2Body: 本網站所載行程、價格與內容僅為初步介紹，實際旅遊內容應以雙方簽訂之旅遊定型化契約為準。契約成立時應包含下列事項：
zh.terms.s2i1: 旅遊內容：行程地點、交通工具、旅館標準、餐食、導遊及領隊安排等。
zh.terms.s2i2: 旅遊日期與人數，以及最低成行人數之限制。
zh.terms.s2i3: 總價、付款方式、訂金金額及其繳付期限。
zh.terms.s2i4: 契約條款、違約金計算方式，以及雙方之權利義務。
zh.terms.s3Body: 旅遊契約成立後，本公司得依契約規定收取訂金。餘款請於出發前依約定日期繳清，逾期未繳者本公司得解除契約並沒收訂金。
zh.terms.s4Body: 出發前，本公司將提供出發說明會或通知，惟您仍應注意下列事項：出發前確認護照及相關證件之有效性；行程可能因天候、疫情、交通或當地因素而變更；參與活動時請遵守現場安全規範並自行評估身體狀況是否適合。
zh.terms.s5Body: 旅遊契約成立後，雙方得依契約所載之取消違約金標準辦理：
zh.terms.s5i1: 旅客於出發前解除契約者，依契約所載期間分級收取違約金。
zh.terms.s5i2: 因不可抗力或不可歸責於雙方之事由致契約無法履行者，本公司協助旅客變更或解除契約。
zh.terms.s6Body: 旅客應提供正確且可聯絡之資料，並遵守旅遊地區之法令規範。旅客因違反法令或未遵循本公司合理指示而致損害者，由旅客自行負責。
zh.terms.s7Body: 因本條款或旅遊契約衍生之爭議，雙方應先以誠信原則協商；協商不成者，得向消費爭議處理委員會申請消費爭議調解，或依法提起訴訟。如有疑問，請來信 {email}。
zh.terms.acknowledge: 您使用本網站並與我們聯絡，即表示已閱讀並同意本條款。

zh.about.title: 關於我們
zh.about.metaDesc: 墾趣國際自 1994 年成立，30 年深耕戶外休閒用品，並以「取之社會、用之社會、回饋社會」為信念成立墾趣旅行社，推動品牌、職場與旅遊三大永續目標。
zh.about.p1: 墾趣國際（墾趣戶外休閒用品）從 1994 年 12 月開業至今已有 30 年，在歷經許多不同階段的成長與茁壯後，我們決定開展更宏大的理念與願景。
zh.about.p2: 秉持著「取之社會、用之社會、回饋社會」的信念，「墾趣旅行社」應運而生。我們不僅將此信念視為公司營運的思維，更是作為實際行動的指引，期望追求更高層次、更長遠的目標。
zh.about.goalsTitle: 墾趣國際三大永續目標
zh.about.goal1Desc: 戶外商品買賣業延伸到旅遊休閒服務業，致力使企業保持長青。
zh.about.goal2Desc: 培養員工的多元能力、提供更佳的職場發展的機會，讓他們在職涯中持續成長。
zh.about.goal3Desc: 我們承諾將「墾趣旅行社」營業額 1% 金額投入環境教育，以長期回饋社會。
zh.about.closing: 墾趣感謝客戶長期的信任與支持，未來我們持續以專業與熱情的服務來回報客戶！

en.privacy.sub: How we collect, use and protect your personal data
en.privacy.metaDesc: Notice on the collection and handling of personal data by FTG TOURS: data controller, items collected, retention period, data security and data subject rights.
en.privacy.s1Body: {name} (the "Company") understands the importance of personal data and handles the personal data you provide when using this website in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act and related regulations. This policy is the Company's notice regarding the processing of personal data.
en.privacy.s2Body: When you contact us through the enquiry form on this website, the Company collects the following data:
en.privacy.dataContactVal: To identify you so that we can get in touch
en.privacy.dataContact2Val: As a channel to contact you and respond to your enquiry
en.privacy.dataRequest: Planned activity date, expected number of participants, activity type
en.privacy.dataRequestVal: To assess feasibility and prepare a tailored itinerary proposal
en.privacy.dataTechVal: To understand your requirements and business background and design a solution aligned with your goals
en.privacy.dataIpVal: Recorded on the server to prevent bot and spam abuse; not used for marketing purposes
en.privacy.dataOptional: All fields are optional except the contact name and email address
en.privacy.s2Note: This website also uses Google reCAPTCHA v3 for bot detection; that service transfers certain technical information to Google (see section 4).
en.privacy.s3Body: The purposes for which the Company collects the above data are as follows:
en.privacy.purposeService: Providing travel services and activity planning
en.privacy.purposeServiceVal: To plan itineraries and arrange transport, accommodation, meals and related services according to your needs
en.privacy.purposeContract: Performance and administration of the contract
en.privacy.purposeContractVal: Signing the standard travel contract, handling deposits and final payments, refunds and cancellations
en.privacy.purposeStatuteVal: Retaining transaction records, preventing fraud, guarding against malicious attacks and handling complaints
en.privacy.s4Body: Some functions of this website are provided by third-party services that may have access to your data. The Company explains the following services to you:
en.privacy.recaptchaBody: This website uses Google reCAPTCHA v3 to identify bots and automated programs. When you submit the enquiry form, Google receives technical information related to that operation.
en.privacy.recaptchaBody2: Under Google's privacy policy, that information may be used for its advertising and personalisation purposes. Google is an overseas recipient, and such transfers are subject to the relevant regulations of Taiwan. If you do not wish to use this service, you may disable JavaScript in your browser, but the form will then not submit correctly.
en.privacy.s5Body: The Company provides your personal data to third parties only in the following circumstances, and never beyond what is necessary for the stated purposes:
en.privacy.shareCloudVal: This website is hosted on Cloudflare for content caching, form reception and data storage; that provider is located overseas.
en.privacy.sharePartner: Partners necessary to perform the tour
en.privacy.sharePartnerVal: Transport, accommodation, catering and venue suppliers, given only the minimum data required to deliver that service.
en.privacy.s6Body: The Company takes the following measures to protect your personal data: data is transmitted over encrypted connections (TLS); data is stored in databases with access controls; only authorised personnel may access it; and the website has bot-protection mechanisms. In the event of a personal data breach, the Company will notify the competent authority and affected individuals in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act.
en.privacy.s7Body: Your personal data is retained until the longest of the following periods: 2 years after completion of the enquiry; for an established travel contract, until 5 years after that contract is fully performed (as required by tax, accounting and travel-industry regulations); or until you request deletion and no statutory retention obligation applies.
en.privacy.s8Body: Under the Personal Data Protection Act, you may exercise the following rights over your personal data held by the Company: access and inspection, request for correction, request for deletion, request for restriction of processing, and request for data portability. To exercise any of these rights, please write to {email} and we will respond within the statutory period. If you believe the Company's processing violates the law, you may lodge a complaint with the central competent authority.
en.privacy.contactUs: If you have any questions about this policy, please contact us

en.terms.s1Body: These terms apply to your use of this website, your contacting us through this website, and your booking of travel products from {name} or receipt of its related services. These terms are drafted in accordance with the Travel Agency Act and the standard travel contract template and related regulations.
en.terms.s2Title: 2. Formation and Content of the Travel Contract
en.terms.s2Body: The itineraries, prices and content shown on this website are preliminary introductions only; the actual travel content is governed by the standard travel contract signed by both parties. A contract must include the following:
en.terms.s2i1: Travel content: destinations, transport, hotel standard, meals, guide and tour leader arrangements.
en.terms.s2i2: Travel dates and number of participants, and any minimum participant requirement.
en.terms.s2i3: Total price, payment method, deposit amount and its payment deadline.
en.terms.s2i4: Contract terms, calculation of cancellation penalties, and the rights and obligations of both parties.
en.terms.s3Body: Once the travel contract is formed, the Company may collect a deposit as provided in the contract. The balance must be paid in full by the agreed date before departure; if payment is overdue, the Company may terminate the contract and forfeit the deposit.
en.terms.s4Body: Before departure, the Company will provide a pre-departure briefing or notice. You should nonetheless note the following: confirm the validity of your passport and related documents before departure; the itinerary may change due to weather, epidemics, transport or local conditions; when taking part in activities, observe on-site safety rules and assess for yourself whether your health is suitable.
en.terms.s5Body: Once the travel contract is formed, both parties may handle cancellation under the graduated cancellation-penalty standard set out in the contract:
en.terms.s5i1: Where a traveller terminates the contract before departure, cancellation penalties are charged on a graduated basis according to the periods stated in the contract.
en.terms.s5i2: Where performance is impossible due to force majeure or causes not attributable to either party, the Company will assist the traveller in changing or terminating the contract.
en.terms.s6Body: Travellers must provide accurate and contactable information and comply with the laws and regulations of the destination. Travellers bear responsibility for damage arising from their breach of law or failure to follow the Company's reasonable instructions.
en.terms.s7Body: Any dispute arising from these terms or the travel contract shall first be resolved through good-faith negotiation. If negotiation fails, either party may apply to the Consumer Dispute Mediation Committee for mediation, or bring proceedings in accordance with the law. If you have questions, please write to {email}.

en.about.title: About Us
en.about.metaDesc: FTG International was founded in 1994 and has spent 30 years in outdoor leisure goods. Inspired by the belief of taking from society, using for society and giving back to society, FTG Travel was established, advancing three sustainability goals for brand, workplace and travel.
en.about.p1: FTG International (FTG outdoor and leisure goods) has been in business since December 1994 — 30 years to date. After growing and strengthening through many different stages, we decided to pursue a broader vision.
en.about.p2: Guided by the belief of "taking from society, using for society, and giving back to society", FTG Travel was born. We do not treat this belief merely as a way of thinking about how we run the company, but as a guide for real action, pursuing goals that are higher-reaching and longer-term.
en.about.goal1Desc: Extending from the outdoor goods retail business into travel and leisure services, working to keep the company strong for the long term.
en.about.goal2Desc: Developing employees’ diverse capabilities and providing better opportunities for professional growth, so they can keep growing throughout their careers.
en.about.goal3Desc: We commit to investing 1% of FTG Travel’s annual revenue into environmental education, giving back to society over the long term.
en.about.closing: FTG thanks customers for their long-standing trust and support. In the future, we will continue to repay you with professional and enthusiastic service.
